fusions.name: Snarl of Strands
fusions.desc: Casts a snarl of strands 4 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Enemies it catches take 10 damage and are stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lashing Fringe
fusions.desc: Lashes a fringe of strands at an enemy up to 4 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Combed Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and heals you for 12 health.

fusions.name: Counted Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once and you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
